kevin_ig.content:
Every business has a ceiling, and most of the time the owner built it out of what they believe.

I've lived most of these. I worked harder, bought another course, carried everything alone and waited for things to slow down before I let myself live.

Breaking them changed how I run my business and my life.

Swipe through and get honest with yourself. Which number is running you right now? Drop it below ⬇️

Do you ever sit there thinking what am I even doing this for? 

Most action you take in your life are patterns. Not consciously taken but an automation ran by your subconscious. Your subconscious is your automatic response system to your life. You don’t intentionally think you just do. 

Most of your actions are a series of repeated patterns that you learned to be comfortable with. It’s very uncomfortable breaking your patterns even if they are toxic. We crave familiarity over just about everything.

This is why less than 25% of people actually make a significant shift in their life course. 

I have been blessed enough to have a radical awakening and transformation to be one of these 25%. 4 years ago I was running from myself chasing every possible escape I could. This picture was a couple days ago when I was sitting in a room about to do something  that I didn’t feel like doing AT ALL. Old me would have ran to familiarity but the new me is awake and conscious enough to recognizing this. 

Now if you read this far you’re probably thinking why the hell are you sharing this. Well I have realized my mission and purpose in life and this is it. To change the level consciousness in business owners and humans in general to excel and live a life that they create rather than falling victim to their circumstances and familiar patterns.

Life is truly a gift and I don’t think less than 25% of ppl needs to be the bar for radical transformation. I believe everyone can do it. And coming from who I was, what I believed and the life I was living I know for a fact you are capable of doing the unexpected. Creating a life that you throughly enjoy filled with abundance and love. You have a mission too and I’m curious what is it?
